# Vetlas

> Vetlas (https://vetlas.thatvetguy.net) is a decision-support tool that helps pet owners in
> India select veterinary care based on attributed, trustworthy data. It is NOT a directory and
> NOT an ad platform: providers cannot pay for rankings or to hide reviews. Every fact carries a
> trust label; nothing is fabricated. The site is in beta with two kinds of records, each clearly
> labelled: SAMPLE demo content (fictional, for product design) and PUBLIC-SOURCE records
> (real providers researched from official websites, public maps and directories, with sources
> and a last-checked date on every profile).

## Key sections

- [Home](https://vetlas.thatvetguy.net/): search across specialities, cities and providers.
- [Find care](https://vetlas.thatvetguy.net/search/): one universal search across cities,
  specialities, hospitals, clinics and doctors, with filters for care type and animal.
- [Specialties](https://vetlas.thatvetguy.net/specialties/): speciality index — medicine,
  surgery, dermatology, gynaecology & obstetrics, radiology & USG, cardiology, gastroenterology,
  ophthalmology, neurology, oncology, emergency care, dentistry, orthopedics, preventive care,
  avian & exotics, physiotherapy.
- [Locations](https://vetlas.thatvetguy.net/locations/): city index (11 cities).
- [Pune & Pimpri-Chinchwad](https://vetlas.thatvetguy.net/pune/): the first real-data city —
  veterinary hospitals, clinics, NGO/government facilities and veterinarians across ~20
  localities of PMC and PCMC, each with source links, last-checked dates and confidence notes.
  City pages enter search indexes only after the publication gate (30 vetted profiles for
  metros) is met; until then they are noindex but freely browsable.
- [Cost guide](https://vetlas.thatvetguy.net/costs/): typical treatment cost ranges for India.
- [Methodology](https://vetlas.thatvetguy.net/methodology/): how verification, review themes,
  AI summaries and expense estimates work (including minimum-sample gates).
- [About](https://vetlas.thatvetguy.net/about/): data policy and trust tiers.

## URL structure

- `/{city}/` — city landing page (e.g. `/pune/`)
- `/{city}/{speciality}/` — city × speciality combination page (e.g. `/mumbai/dermatology/`)
- `/{city}/{provider-slug}/` — provider profile (facility or doctor), e.g.
  `/pune/raintree-veterinary-clinic-uday-baug/`, `/pune/dr-amey-nirmale/`
- `/{city}/{speciality}/` pages are indexed only when ≥3 vetted providers match.

## Trust tiers

- **Verified**: manually checked by Vetlas staff (date-stamped).
- **Provider-confirmed**: confirmed directly by the provider.
- **Public source**: from public pages/maps/directories, with fetch date, source links,
  research notes and a confidence level (high/medium/low).
- **User-submitted**: moderated owner reports.
- **Estimated**: system-calculated; displayed only above minimum sample sizes.

## Emergency-care honesty

Facilities advertising 24-hour cover are distinguished from confirmed 24-hour clinical staffing.
Where a listing's round-the-clock status is only a directory/website claim, the profile says
"call before a night visit" explicitly.

## Data status

- SAMPLE dataset: fictional, for beta UI testing; never presented as real.
- PUBLIC-SOURCE dataset (starting with Pune & PCMC, batches 1–3, researched 2026-11-16; 88 facilities and 33 doctors across ~34 localities):
  real providers; every rating is an attributed snapshot from the named platform (Google,
  Practo/Lybrate/Sploot); adverse review themes are recorded alongside positive ones;
  self-published credentials are marked as such and never counted as verified.
